clients.name: OrderFlow APIs

clients.name: OrderFlow local development
clients.description: Public PKCE client for trying the APIs from Scalar on localhost.

clients.name: Orders service account
clients.description: Client credentials for service-to-service gRPC calls made by Orders. The secret is generated by Keycloak.

clients.name: OrderFlow web (BFF)
clients.description: Confidential client of the BFF: Authorization Code + PKCE, tokens stay on the server. The secret comes from KEYCLOAK_BFF_CLIENT_SECRET at import.

clientScopes.name: roles

clientScopes.name: acr

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to
